question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires total ?
sql_reference: SELECT ROUND(SUM(montant_total) / 1e6, 1) AS ca_millions_fcfa FROM v_ventes

question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires par année ?
sql_reference: SELECT annee, ROUND(SUM(montant_total) / 1e6, 1) AS ca_millions_fcfa FROM v_ventes GROUP BY annee ORDER BY annee

question: Quel est le CA mois par mois en 2026 ?
sql_reference: SELECT mois, ROUND(SUM(montant_total) / 1e6, 1) AS ca_millions_fcfa FROM v_ventes WHERE annee = 2026 GROUP BY mois ORDER BY mois

question: Combien de commandes avons-nous vendues par ville ?
sql_reference: SELECT ville, COUNT(*) AS nb_commandes FROM v_ventes GROUP BY ville ORDER BY nb_commandes DESC

question: Quel est le panier moyen par ville ?
sql_reference: SELECT ville, ROUND(AVG(montant_total)) AS panier_moyen_fcfa FROM v_ventes GROUP BY ville ORDER BY panier_moyen_fcfa DESC

question: Quels sont les 10 vendeurs qui font le plus de chiffre d'affaires ?
sql_reference: SELECT vendeur, ROUND(SUM(montant_ligne) / 1e6, 1) AS ca_millions_fcfa FROM v_lignes_ventes GROUP BY vendeur ORDER BY SUM(montant_ligne) DESC LIMIT 10

question: Quelles sont les 5 catégories qui rapportent le plus ?
sql_reference: SELECT categorie_principale, ROUND(SUM(montant_ligne) / 1e6, 1) AS ca_millions_fcfa FROM v_lignes_ventes GROUP BY categorie_principale ORDER BY SUM(montant_ligne) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Quels sont les 10 articles les plus vendus en quantité ?
sql_reference: SELECT article, SUM(quantite) AS quantite_vendue FROM v_lignes_ventes GROUP BY article ORDER BY quantite_vendue DESC LIMIT 10

question: Combien de clients différents ont acheté chez nous ?
sql_reference: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS nb_clients FROM v_ventes

question: Combien de clients ont commandé au moins deux fois ?
sql_reference: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_clients_fideles FROM (SELECT client_id FROM v_ventes GROUP BY client_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)

question: Quel est notre taux d'annulation ?
sql_reference: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN statut = 'Annulée' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS taux_annulation_pct FROM commandes

question: Comment se répartissent les commandes par statut ?
sql_reference: SELECT statut, COUNT(*) AS nb_commandes FROM commandes GROUP BY statut ORDER BY nb_commandes DESC

question: Quel est le CA de chaque commune d'Abidjan ?
sql_reference: SELECT commune, ROUND(SUM(montant_total) / 1e6, 1) AS ca_millions_fcfa FROM v_ventes WHERE ville = 'Abidjan' GROUP BY commune ORDER BY SUM(montant_total) DESC

question: Quel mois de 2025 a fait le meilleur chiffre d'affaires ?
sql_reference: SELECT mois, ROUND(SUM(montant_total) / 1e6, 1) AS ca_millions_fcfa FROM v_ventes WHERE annee = 2025 GROUP BY mois ORDER BY SUM(montant_total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Combien de commandes ont un montant suspect ?
sql_reference: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_commandes_suspectes FROM commandes WHERE montant_suspect
